title: Observe removal of a yellow card in an isolated battle
changes: Document a user-guided Stop violation and one CH-0339 application in an isolated EUR final-battle scene.
validation: Protected Wine/Xvfb session: forbidden Stop produced a visible yellow card on Nusrat; one maintained application recorded 24 writes and changed a target 256 to 0. After reopening status, the displayed yellow count changed from 1 to 0 and the target stayed zero for 192 frames after disarm, without more writes (dbg22-royal-stop-live-zprjyv6n).

A protected no-cheat Wine replay matched the full pre-application state, frame and clock; one and 193 frames later it retained target 256 and displayed one yellow card while the candidate had zero, at matching frames and clocks (dbg22-royal-card-control-2rzyo45b).
limitations: One yellow-card case and one source: red cards, other units and side effects, native Windows and original device behavior remain unverified.
